title: Murmuring Moonlight Mollusk
statement: A pearly, translucent nautilus-snail that hums in low bubbly notes as it drifts through a tank of deep indigo water, each murmur lighting the glowing spiral of its shell a little brighter. It spends its evenings gathering tiny lanterns of bioluminescent algae from a tangle of silver kelp and stacking them, very carefully, on a mossy teacup-shaped rock, where it hopes someone will come for tea.
